CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD | ACTION MINUTES
  REGULAR MEETING – 7:00 P.M.
  City Hall Conference Room A
  111 South First Street

February 13, 2024

A. CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:01 P.M. in the Conference Room A of Alhambra
  City Hall.

B. ROLL CALL:
Present:
NORA HERNANDEZ, VICE CHAIRMAN
STANLEY TSAI, MEMBER
MICHAEL DANINGER, MEMBER
JENNIFER NG, MEMBER
STEVE KUCHENSKI, SECRETARY

Absent:
ANKIT UDANI, CHAIRMAN

Staff Present:
ERIC D. MARTINEZ

C. CONSENT CALENDAR:

ITEM 1:  MINUTES: January 23, 2024

  •  Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve as submitted
  the minutes of the January 23, 2024 meeting of the Design Review Board.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Daninger makes a motion to approve all consent items.
  •  The second was by Board Member Ng.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recording of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

  1
 D. DISCUSSION ITEMS:

ITEM 2:  2122 South Fremont Avenue

  •  Request: This is an application to legalize one (1) 16-foot-wide metal rolling gate
  mounted on the outside of an existing 1-story commercial building concealed
  behind an existing storefront awing.
  •  Applicant: Mohamed Elshahawy
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL WITH CONDITIONS - The proposed
  project is approved with the following conditions of approval: 1) The rolling gate
  must be concealed behind an awning or canopy during normal business hours.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Ng makes a motion to continue the application with conditions as
  follows: 1) The applicant shall work with the City Architect to further study and
  select an alternative gate material and/or type of high quality and design
  aesthetic, and to then come back to Design Review Board for review.
  •  The second was by Board member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recording of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

ITEM 3:  1210 North Atlantic Boulevard

  •  Request: This is an application for new CMU smooth face screen walls, a curved
  seating wall adjacent outdoor dining area, and a new 584 SF, 11’-9” tall covered
  trash enclosure on site.
  •  Applicant: Michelle Bennett & Michelle Chen
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Tsai makes a motion to approve the application without
  conditions.
  •  The second was by Board member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recording of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

  2
 ITEM 4:  1700 Sarazen Drive

  •  Request: This is an application for a new 208 SF 1-story addition on the East side
  and 290 SF 1-story addition in the rear of an existing 1-story single-family
  residence.
  •  Applicant: Thuy To & Maria Arias
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.

MOTION:
  • Board member Tsai makes a motion to approve the application with conditions
  as follows: 1) The applicant shall work with City Staff on graphically revising the
  roof line in roof plan and elevations.
  • The second was by Board member Daninger.
  • The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  • For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recording of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

ITEM 5:  2800 Front Street

  •  Request: This is an application for a new 123 SF 1-story addition in the rear of an
  existing 949 SF 1-story single-family residence.
  •  Applicant: Frank Freeman
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.

MOTION:
  • Board member Michael makes a motion to approve the application without
  conditions.
  • The second was by Board member Tsai.
  • The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  • For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recording of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

E. ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 7:08 P.M. to
  February 27, 2024.

MOTION:

  •  Board Member Daninger moved to adjourn the meeting at 8:08 P.M.
  •  The second was by Ng.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
